# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Sami: Sweden 1970 and Nordic cooperation.
# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Swedish 1970 integration.
# Generated by tools/sweden_1970/integrate.py.
on_actions = {
    on_startup = {
        effect = {
            SWE = {
                COLDWAR_SWE_initialise_effect = yes
                # MD's economic startup can run after this hook. Retry once,
                # after every startup hook, rather than leave desks shut a month.
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        exists = yes
                        IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
                        NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_systems_initialised }
                    }
                    country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SWE_BOOTSTRAP.1 days = 1 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    # Monthly Swedish registry in the native tag-specific hook.
    on_monthly_SWE = {
        effect = {
            if = {
                limit = { tag = SWE original_tag = SWE exists = yes IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
                COLDWAR_SWE_initialise_effect = yes
                COLDWAR_SWE_national_monthly_effect = yes
                COLDWAR_SWE_systems_monthly_effect = yes
                # IMPERIA COLD WAR — one optional historical report at a time.
                COLDWAR_SWE_history_monthly_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
    on_weekly_SWE = {
        effect = {
            if = {
                limit = { tag = SWE original_tag = SWE exists = yes IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_systems_initialised }
                COLDWAR_SWE_ikea_retail_weekly_effect = yes
                COLDWAR_SWE_company_weekly_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
    on_ruling_party_change = {
        effect = {
            if = {
                limit = { tag = SWE original_tag = SWE exists = yes IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
                COLDWAR_SWE_national_refresh_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
    on_new_term_election = {
        effect = {
            if = {
                limit = { tag = SWE original_tag = SWE exists = yes IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
                COLDWAR_SWE_national_on_election_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
    # ROOT annexes FROM. Close Sweden's undelivered escrow while its saved
    # registry is still addressable; completed goods never refund a second time.
    on_annex = {
        effect = {
            if = {
                limit = { FROM = { tag = SWE original_tag = SWE IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes } }
                FROM = { COLDWAR_SWE_systems_close_external_effect = yes }
            }
        }
    }
}
